socratic_gate.name: SOCRATIC_CLARIFICATION_GATE v1.0.0
socratic_gate.scope: Only for high-risk ambiguity. Does NOT apply to normal execution phases.
trigger_conditions: Direction conflict: two active strategies contradict each other
Unclear scope: phase boundary is ambiguous and could lead to overreach
Release/deploy/security/secret boundary: any action touching these boundaries
Evidence classification ambiguous: design vs execution, local vs production
User intent unclear: could be interpreted as release when user means trial
anti_patterns: Socratic Gate blocking normal execution → VIOLATION (high-risk only)
Socratic Gate asking already-answered question → VIOLATION
Every phase triggers Socratic → VIOLATION (high-risk only)
